description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a scheme aimed at enhancing fish production and productivity in India. 

It was launched to promote sustainable development of the fisheries sector. 

The objectives include increasing fish production to 22 million metric tons by 2024-25. 

It also aims to provide employment opportunities and improve the livelihoods of fishers and fish farmers. 

The scheme offers financial assistance for various activities such as aquaculture, fisheries infrastructure, and marketing. 

The benefits include access to modern technology, improved fish seed and feed supply, and better market linkages. 

Eligibility criteria typically include fishers, fish farmers, and individuals or groups involved in the fisheries sector. 

The application process involves submitting a proposal to the respective state fisheries department or implementing agency. 

The timeline for approval and disbursement of funds may vary based on the project and state guidelines. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries under the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

It is part of the broader initiative to promote Blue Revolution in India.
